# Rule: Enable the Content Identification Function During Agent Orchestration and Release

**Description**: During agent orchestration and release, if the business side cannot determine whether the content generated by the agent is compliant, the content identification function needs to be enabled.

**Check guide**: Open the agent orchestration page, and check whether the content identification function is enabled in the **Result Display Settings** area.

**Positive example**:

![[en-us_image_0000002364892657.png]]

**Tool supported or not**: yes

**Specification name**: Security\_Agent\_AI\_Safety\_Note

**Category**: bottom-line check item

**Severity**: critical

**Orchestration scenario**: agent orchestration
